LuxePass — Epic 6: Member Experience & Notifications
Same light design system and app shell as Phases 1, 3, 4, 5 and 6. UI copy in English.
Managing what you booked → what we tell you and when → who you are and what we keep about you.

Story 6.1 · One section holds the four states a booking can be in — confirmed, in progress, completed, cancelled — plus the waitlist that has no pass yet. Cancelling is the only change a member can make, and the policy decides which of the two dialogs opens: free more than 24 hours ahead, a flat $35.00 fee inside the window. Past visits keep the confirmation number, so any booking email can be sent again, and a no-show is written into the record with what it cost.

Story 6.2 · Six kinds of message live in one centre: booking confirmations, the 6 AM reminder on the day of a visit, new partner lounges, membership renewal, offers, and the birthday month. Booking news is unmissable — email is always on and quiet hours never hold it back. Everything else is a switch per channel, and the day-of reminder carries the time control that makes 6 AM a default rather than a rule.

Story 6.3 · Account keeps a sub-nav of its own: the same fields captured at sign-up, the favorites and amenities that order Explore, the notification switches, and privacy. Membership status and the referral code sit beside the profile as read-only cards — the plan itself and the referral rewards are Epic 9. Deleting the account says out loud what it cancels and what it charges, and offers pausing instead.

Seams declared, not designed here: the support conversation behind every "contact support" row is Epic 8; managing the plan, pausing it and the referral rewards are Epic 9; the partner's side of a no-show is Story 7.1.
